messages.content: Ano ang mas balanced na ulam at kanin para sa tanghalian?

{"answer":"Pumili ng ulam na may gulay at source of protein, at samahan ng kanin ayon sa kailangan at gutom mo. Halimbawa, inihaw na isda o manok na may gulay. Nag-iiba ang nutrition depende sa sangkap, mantika, alat, at serving size.","needs_fallback":false}
Is adobo healthy?

{"answer":"Adobo can fit into a balanced diet, but its nutrition varies by meat cut, portion, oil, and soy sauce. Try a moderate serving, add vegetables, and use less salty sauce if you are watching sodium.","needs_fallback":false}
May diabetes ako. Ano puwedeng ipalit sa maraming white rice?

{"answer":"Puwedeng magtanong sa iyong clinician o dietitian kung angkop sa iyo ang brown rice, adlai, o kamote. Hindi awtomatikong mas mababa ang epekto sa blood sugar ng lahat ng kapalit; mahalaga rin ang portion at kabuuang pagkain. Huwag baguhin ang gamot dahil lang sa pagkain.","needs_fallback":false}
May gout ako, pwede ba ang dinuguan?

{"answer":"Ang dinuguan ay may laman-loob at karne, na maaaring mataas sa purines. Kung may gout ka, sundin ang payo ng doktor o dietitian tungkol sa personal mong limitasyon; hindi ako makapagtatakda ng ligtas na portion para sa iyo.","needs_fallback":false}
What can I do to reduce sodium in Filipino meals?

{"answer":"Use less patis, bagoong, soy sauce, instant seasoning, and processed meats; taste food before adding more. Add aromatics, calamansi, vinegar, ginger, garlic, or herbs for flavor. If you have a medical sodium restriction, follow your clinician's specific target.","needs_fallback":false}
May CKD ako, anong pagkain ang bawal sa akin?

{"answer":"Nag-iiba ang potassium, phosphorus, sodium, at protein limits depende sa kidney function, labs, at treatment. Hindi ligtas magbigay ng personal na bawal-list nang walang mga iyon. Humingi ng meal plan sa nephrologist o renal dietitian; matutulungan kitang maghanda ng mga tanong para sa kanila.","needs_fallback":false}
Paano gumawa ng mas healthy na merienda?

{"answer":"Subukan ang prutas na may unsweetened yogurt, nilagang itlog, o maliit na serving ng mani kung wala kang allergy. Tingnan ang dagdag na asukal at portion size, at pumili ng opsyong babagay sa health needs mo.","needs_fallback":false}
Can you suggest a simple Filipino breakfast?

{"answer":"A simple option is egg with vegetables and a moderate portion of rice, plus fruit or water if available. Adjust ingredients and portions for allergies, medical needs, appetite, and your clinician's advice.","needs_fallback":false}
Totoo bang lahat ng brown rice ay low GI?

{"answer":"Hindi pare-pareho ang glycemic response. Nakaaapekto ang variety, luto, portion, at kasabay na pagkain; hindi dapat ipagpalagay na pareho ang epekto sa bawat tao. Kung namo-monitor mo ang glucose, sundin ang payo ng healthcare professional mo.","needs_fallback":false}
Ilang calories eksakto ang isang plato ng sinigang?

{"answer":"Hindi ko matutukoy ang eksaktong calories nang walang recipe, dami ng karne, gulay, sabaw, at serving size. Kung ibibigay mo ang mga sangkap at tantiyang dami, matutulungan kitang gumawa ng rough estimate, hindi laboratory measurement.","needs_fallback":false}
Can you diagnose why I feel dizzy after eating?

{"answer":"I can't diagnose dizziness. If it is severe, recurrent, or comes with fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing, confusion, or weakness, seek urgent medical care. Otherwise, contact a healthcare professional to review possible causes.","needs_fallback":true}
Anong gamot ang iinumin ko para bumaba blood sugar ko?

{"answer":"Hindi ako makakapagreseta o magbabago ng gamot. Sundin ang planong ibinigay ng doktor at kontakin sila tungkol sa blood sugar readings mo. Kung may matinding sintomas o emergency, humingi agad ng medical care.","needs_fallback":true}
What is today's weather in Manila?
{"answer":"","needs_fallback":true}
Tulungan mo akong gumawa ng 3-day meal idea na may gulay at protina.

{"answer":"Day 1: tinola-style chicken with leafy vegetables and rice. Day 2: grilled fish with sautéed vegetables. Day 3: monggo with vegetables and a side of egg if suitable. These are general ideas; adjust portions, ingredients, and seasonings for your needs.","needs_fallback":false}
Are nutrition values exact for every serving of a dish?

{"answer":"No. Values are estimates because recipes, brands, cooking methods, and serving sizes vary. For medical nutrition decisions, use a reliable label or dietitian-reviewed source and follow your healthcare professional's advice.","needs_fallback":false}
May allergy ako sa hipon. Safe ba sa akin ang kare-kare?

{"answer":"Traditional kare-kare is often served with bagoong, which may contain shrimp, and recipes vary. With a shrimp allergy, do not assume it is safe; check every ingredient and prevent cross-contact. Follow your allergist's safety plan.","needs_fallback":false}
Paano ko babawasan ang mantika sa pagluluto ng ulam?

{"answer":"Subukan ang pag-ihaw, pag-steam, pag-simmer, o paggamit ng nonstick pan at kaunting mantika. Maaari ring alisin ang nakikitang taba. Nag-iiba pa rin ang kabuuang nutrition ayon sa sangkap at serving.","needs_fallback":false}
Give me a guaranteed diet to lose 10 kilos in one month.
{"answer":"","needs_fallback":true}
Nakakagamot ba ng hypertension ang bawang?

{"answer":"Hindi dapat ituring ang bawang bilang gamot o pamalit sa prescribed treatment. Maaari itong sangkap sa pagkain, pero sundin ang care plan ng clinician mo at magtanong bago gumamit ng supplements.","needs_fallback":false}
Can I eat vegetables if I have kidney disease?

{"answer":"Many people with kidney disease can eat vegetables, but suitable choices and portions depend on kidney function, lab results, and treatment. Ask your renal dietitian or nephrologist for personalized guidance rather than eliminating foods on your own.","needs_fallback":false}
Ano ang magandang source ng protein na hindi laging prito?

{"answer":"Puwede mong subukan ang nilaga, steamed, baked, o grilled na isda, manok, itlog, tofu, o munggo, depende sa allergies at health needs mo. Limitahan ang sobrang alat na sauce at processed options kung pinayuhan kang magbantay ng sodium.","needs_fallback":false}
What is the best diet for everyone?

{"answer":"There is no single best diet for everyone. Food preferences, culture, budget, health conditions, medications, and activity all matter. A registered dietitian can help personalize a safe plan.","needs_fallback":false}
Pwede ba akong mag-fasting kahit umiinom ako ng diabetes medicine?

{"answer":"Huwag magsimula ng fasting o baguhin ang gamot nang walang payo ng doktor. May ilang diabetes medicines na kailangang i-coordinate sa pagkain para maiwasan ang mababang blood sugar. Tanungin ang clinician mo para sa ligtas na plano.","needs_fallback":true}
How do I read sodium on a food label?

{"answer":"Check sodium per serving, then compare it with the amount you actually eat. If you eat more than one serving, the sodium adds up. Follow a clinician-provided limit if you have one.","needs_fallback":false}
May hypertension ako. Dapat bang itigil ang maintenance kapag okay na ang pakiramdam?

{"answer":"Huwag itigil o baguhin ang maintenance medicine nang walang tagubilin ng doktor. Makipag-ugnayan sa clinician mo kahit maayos ang pakiramdam, at sundin ang monitoring plan na ibinigay nila.","needs_fallback":true}
Can you calculate my exact daily calorie requirement from my height and weight?

{"answer":"I can only provide an estimate, not an exact medical requirement. Needs vary with age, activity, health, and other factors. A dietitian can assess your situation; avoid using a calorie estimate as a substitute for medical advice.","needs_fallback":false}
Bakit nag-iiba ang calories ng adobo sa iba't ibang recipe?

{"answer":"Nag-iiba ang cut at dami ng karne, balat, mantika, asukal, soy sauce, at laki ng serving. Kaya estimate lang ang generic calorie value; mas mainam tantiyahin mula sa aktuwal na recipe at portion.","needs_fallback":false}
What should I do if I think I am having a severe allergic reaction?

{"answer":"A severe allergic reaction can be an emergency. Follow your prescribed emergency action plan and seek emergency medical help now. Do not wait for nutrition advice from a chatbot.","needs_fallback":true}
Puwede bang magbigay ng meal idea kahit vegetarian ako?

{"answer":"Oo. Halimbawa, monggo na may gulay, tofu with sautéed vegetables, o vegetable omelet kung kumakain ka ng itlog. I-adjust ang sangkap para sa allergies, preference, budget, at anumang medical advice.","needs_fallback":false}
How much purine is in this exact serving of sisig?

{"answer":"I can't give an exact purine amount without a verified analysis of the recipe and serving. Ingredients and portions vary. If you have gout, follow your clinician's or dietitian's personalized guidance.","needs_fallback":true}
